200.description:
One SeatGeek event by id or public URL (api.seatgeek.com /2/events/{id}): the search_events record plus description, provider ids at other ticketing sites, seating map configuration and sales end. Availability is the API's event-level stats snapshot (listing and ticket counts, price range across listings); per-listing offers with section, row and quantity live behind DataDome (/2/event_listings_v2) and are not available. Unknown ids fail with not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `all_in_price_on_event_page` | boolean | Whether the site shows all-in (fee-inclusive) prices on this event's page. |
| `announce_date` | string |  |
| `availability` | object | Event-level availability snapshot from the API's stats object: counts and price range across all marketplace listings (primary and resale are not distinguished at this level). A snapshot, not a reservation. Null when the API sends no stats. Per-listing offers (section, row, quantity) are behind DataDome and not available from this program. |
| `date_tbd` | boolean | Date not yet announced. |
| `datetime_local` | string | Local start time at the venue, ISO 8601 without offset (see timezone). May be a placeholder when time_tbd/date_tbd is true. |
| `datetime_tbd` | boolean | Date and time not yet announced. |
| `datetime_utc` | string | Start time in UTC, ISO 8601 without the Z suffix as the API sends it. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `enddatetime_utc` | string |  |
| `external_ids` | object[] | Ids of the same event at other ticketing providers (event.links[] with link_type ID plus event.ticketmaster). |
| `id` | number | SeatGeek event id; stable identifier, last path segment of the public event URL. |
| `is_open` | boolean | Whether the API marks the event as open. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when this snapshot was taken by the program. |
| `performers` | object[] |  |
| `sales_end_datetime_utc` | string |  |
| `schedule_status` | string | Scheduling status as the API states it; observed: as_originally_scheduled, rescheduled. |
| `seating_map` | object | Seating map configuration from event.venue_config; null when absent. |
| `short_title` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string | The API request the record came from (api.seatgeek.com). |
| `status` | string | Event status as the API states it; observed: normal. Cancelled or postponed values were not observed during reconnaissance. |
| `taxonomies` | object[] |  |
| `time_tbd` | boolean | Time not yet announced. |
| `timezone` | string | IANA timezone of datetime_local, from the venue. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `type` | string | Event type as the API states it (mlb, concert, entertainment, ...). |
| `url` | string | Public event page on seatgeek.com (source URL). |
| `venue` | object | The venue the event is at; null when the API has none (TBA events). |

200.description:

At least one filter is required. Each event carries its stable id, public URL, local and UTC start, venue with timezone, performers, taxonomies, status/schedule_status and an event-level availability snapshot (listing and ticket counts, price range).
